Intro to Animations

Source: vignettes/articles/r-docs/animations.Rmd
animations.Rmd

Frames

Now, along with data and layout, frames is added to the keys that figure allows. Your frames key points to a list of figures, each of which will be cycled through upon instantiation of the plot. With plotly.core, build the frames yourself (each frame holds the trace values to show at that step) and add a play button with go_updatemenu() and a slider with go_slider().

Basic Example 

library(plotly.core)

df <- data.frame(
  x = c(1,2,1), 
  y = c(1,2,1), 
  f = c(1,2,3)
)

fig <- df[df$f == 1, ] |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(x = ~x, y = ~y, mode = "markers", showlegend = FALSE)

fig$frames <- lapply(df$f, function(f) {
  list(
    name = as.character(f),
    data = list(go_scatter(x = df$x[df$f == f], y = df$y[df$f == f]))
  )
})

fig <- fig |>
  update_layout(
    xaxis = go_xaxis(range = c(0.9, 2.1)),
    yaxis = go_yaxis(range = c(0.9, 2.1)),
    updatemenus = list(
      go_updatemenu(
        type = "buttons",
        showactive = FALSE,
        x = 0,
        y = 0,
        yanchor = "top",
        pad = go_updatemenu_pad(t = 60, r = 10),
        xanchor = "right",
        buttons = list(
          go_updatemenu_button(
            label = "Play",
            method = "animate",
            args = list(NULL, list(fromcurrent = TRUE, mode = "immediate"))
          )
        )
      )
    ),
    sliders = list(
      go_slider(
        pad = go_slider_pad(t = 50),
        steps = lapply(df$f, function(f) {
          go_slider_step(
            label = as.character(f),
            method = "animate",
            args = list(list(as.character(f)), list(mode = "immediate"))
          )
        })
      )
    )
  )

fig

Mulitple Trace Animations

One trace per continent, and one frame per year holding the values of every trace for that year. play_button() and year_slider() build the animation controls; the following sections change their options.

library(plotly.core)
library(gapminder)

df <- as.data.frame(gapminder)
years <- sort(unique(df$year))
continents <- levels(df$continent)
# marker area proportional to population
sizeref <- 2 * max(df$pop) / 60^2

continent_trace <- function(d) {
  go_scatter(
    x = d$gdpPercap,
    y = d$lifeExp,
    text = d$country,
    marker = go_scatter_marker(size = d$pop, sizemode = "area", sizeref = sizeref)
  )
}

fig <- df[df$year == years[1], ] |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(
    x = ~gdpPercap,
    y = ~lifeExp,
    text = ~country,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = go_scatter_marker(
      color = ~continent,
      size = ~pop,
      sizemode = "area",
      sizeref = sizeref
    )
  )

fig$frames <- lapply(years, function(yr) {
  list(
    name = as.character(yr),
    data = lapply(continents, function(cont) {
      continent_trace(df[df$continent == cont & df$year == yr, ])
    })
  )
})

animation_args <- function(frames, duration, easing) {
  list(
    frames,
    list(
      frame = list(duration = duration, redraw = FALSE),
      transition = list(duration = duration, easing = easing),
      fromcurrent = TRUE,
      mode = "immediate"
    )
  )
}

play_button <- function(duration = 500, easing = "linear", ...) {
  go_updatemenu(
    type = "buttons",
    showactive = FALSE,
    ...,
    buttons = list(
      go_updatemenu_button(
        label = "Play",
        method = "animate",
        args = animation_args(NULL, duration, easing)
      )
    )
  )
}

year_slider <- function(duration = 500, easing = "linear", ...) {
  go_slider(
    pad = go_slider_pad(t = 50),
    ...,
    steps = lapply(years, function(yr) {
      go_slider_step(
        label = as.character(yr),
        method = "animate",
        args = animation_args(list(as.character(yr)), duration, easing)
      )
    })
  )
}

fig <- fig |>
  update_layout(
    xaxis = go_xaxis(type = "log", range = log10(range(df$gdpPercap)) + c(-0.1, 0.1)),
    yaxis = go_yaxis(range = range(df$lifeExp) + c(-5, 5)),
    updatemenus = list(
      play_button(x = 0, xanchor = "right", y = 0, yanchor = "top", pad = go_updatemenu_pad(t = 60, r = 10))
    ),
    sliders = list(year_slider())
  )

fig

Add Animation Options 

library(plotly.core)

fig <- fig |>
  update_layout(
    updatemenus = list(
      play_button(1000, "elastic", x = 0, xanchor = "right", y = 0, yanchor = "top", pad = go_updatemenu_pad(t = 60, r = 10))
    ),
    sliders = list(year_slider(1000, "elastic"))
  )

fig

Add Button Options 

library(plotly.core)

fig <- fig |>
  update_layout(
    updatemenus = list(
      play_button(1000, "elastic", x = 1, xanchor = "right", y = 0, yanchor = "bottom")
    )
  )

fig

Add Slider Options 

library(plotly.core)

fig <- fig |>
  update_layout(
    sliders = list(
      year_slider(
        1000,
        "elastic",
        currentvalue = go_slider_currentvalue(prefix = "YEAR ", font = go_font(color = "red"))
      )
    )
  )

fig

Advanced Example 

library(plotly.core)

fig <- df[df$year == years[1], ] |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(
    x = ~gdpPercap,
    y = ~lifeExp,
    text = ~country,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = go_scatter_marker(
      color = ~continent,
      size = ~pop,
      sizemode = "area",
      sizeref = sizeref
    )
  )

fig$frames <- lapply(years, function(yr) {
  list(
    name = as.character(yr),
    data = lapply(continents, function(cont) {
      continent_trace(df[df$continent == cont & df$year == yr, ])
    })
  )
})

fig <- fig |>
  update_layout(
    xaxis = go_xaxis(type = "log", range = log10(range(df$gdpPercap)) + c(-0.1, 0.1)),
    yaxis = go_yaxis(range = range(df$lifeExp) + c(-5, 5)),
    updatemenus = list(
      play_button(1000, "elastic", x = 1, xanchor = "right", y = 0, yanchor = "bottom")
    ),
    sliders = list(
      year_slider(
        1000,
        "elastic",
        currentvalue = go_slider_currentvalue(prefix = "YEAR ", font = go_font(color = "red"))
      )
    )
  )
